text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! Why did we have to clean the stands
on such a windy day of all days—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Gah...!
Sand got in my mouth...!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...,
my mouth tastes all gritty...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My hair and face are covered in sand... and besides,
no matter how much we clean, it's totally pointless!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps getting covered in dust got to her,
because Durandal's mood took a total nosedive for the rest of the day."
